title.zh: Hiddify 多协议支持深度拆解：从传统 Shadowsocks 到 Reality、TUIC 与 WireGuard 融合
title.en: Hiddify Multi-Protocol Deep Dive: Seamless Fusion of Shadowsocks, Reality, TUIC & WireGuard

description.zh: 硬核协议技术全景剖析：Hiddify 客户端如何无缝兼容并自动化调度传统 SS、VMess、Trojan 与现代抗封锁协议（VLESS-Reality、TUIC v5、Hysteria 2、WireGuard）。解析跨协议聚合与动态链路容灾实操。
description.en: Comprehensive architectural breakdown of Hiddify's multi-protocol capabilities. Explore how it aggregates Shadowsocks, VMess, Trojan, VLESS-Reality, TUIC v5, and Hysteria 2 into a fault-tolerant routing pipeline.
